what: A card like a phone notification, a translucent gray panel (blur 10px) holding a logo cell, two lines of text and a tag on the right (CONTACT · VIEW). On hover the tag position shifts 26px to the right and fades (layout animation, where a transform from the new position back to the old one is resolved by a spring), and an arrow cell turns on in its place (spring bounce .2 · .4s). With shift set, the card stays raised by that amount while scrolling down and returns with the same spring when scrolling up. A fixed top-right notification group that fills the space the header row leaves as it scrolls away

options.shift: Distance to move while scrolling down (px), default 0 (no movement) — top-right group -34 in the original
options.step: Scrolls that move less than this many px don’t count as a direction, default 1
options.hide: Selector — when the section’s top edge enters below the screen (even after passing it) the card disappears with the same spring, and returns when scrolled back above it. The haptic second card (new case) is the client logo section .hp-clients
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Tag swap, rise/fall length and curve (via style), default .4s · linear() of Framer spring bounce .2
options.[data-fx-part=icon · text · sub · label: Logo cell · text group · second line (faded) · right-side tag · arrow cell that lights up on hover (overlaps 16px on the card’s right side)
